full_judgment: 13. Upon going through the judgment of the lower appellate court we have been taken by surprise to see that the appellate Court below without adverting to the points upon which the trial court dis-missed the suit reversed the same which is certainly not a proper reversal of judgment and decree on the part of the appellate Court. It has arrived at a decision absolutely in a slipshod and cryptic manner. This is not at all a reversal in terms of Order XLI Rule 31 of the Code of Civil Procedure.
